sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 18 March 2026, pitch SYN-SYNCP000154-P1 was put before Desert Bloom Family Clinic 154 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a group service charge of 1.5 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Influenza minimum take of 850 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer has not yet responded.
